label: Tessera · Walkthrough
description: Editable walkthrough section for the Tessera design.

defaults.heading: One schema, four steps to a live backend
defaults.description: Define it once. Tessera builds the database, the API, and the types, and keeps them in sync while you ship.

steps.title: Schema
steps.description: Define tables, relations, and rules in TypeScript. One schema powers your database, API, and types.

steps.title: Data
steps.description: Push, and Tessera plans a safe migration from the diff. Every branch gets its own copy of the data.

steps.title: Query
steps.description: Query with a typed builder. Change a column and the compiler shows you what breaks.

steps.title: Live
steps.description: Subscribe to any query. Presence and broadcast are built in, with no sockets to manage.
